description_en: You can call SetLiveStreamDelayConfig to configure live streaming latency
kebab_example: aliyun live set-live-stream-delay-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetLiveStreamDelayConfig

parameters.help_en:
The HLS playback latency. Unit: seconds.

If this parameter is left empty, the latency is set based on the value of HlsLevel
parameters.help_zh:
HLS播放延迟时间。单位：秒。

该参数为空时，按照HlsLevel延迟级别对应的时间设置
parameters.name: hls_delay

parameters.help_en:
The HLS latency level. This parameter is ignored if HlsDelay is set.

Valid values:

short (default): 3 seconds.

medium: 6 seconds.

long: 15 seconds.

If both HlsDelay and HlsLevel are left empty, the default value short is used
parameters.help_zh:
HLS延迟级别。配置了HlsDelay情况下忽略该参数。

取值如下：

short（默认）：表示延迟时间为3秒。

medium：表示延迟时间为6秒。

long：表示延迟时间为15秒。

如果HlsDelay和HlsLevel参数都为空，则按照默认值short进行配置
